_doc: Decisions after looking at the QA sheets (tools/lego3d/brick-sheets.mjs) for the bricks that the automatic rule (brick-table.mjs: box <= 0.045, mean <= 0.02, far <= 8 %) does not pass or that pass but look wrong. accept = same element, deviations are details of the game's simplified model; reject = reason (documented in the report).

accept.arch2x8x1: same arch; LDraw's hollow deck shows from below
accept.car_grill: same grille shape; the game's bars are simpler
accept.dish2x2: same dish; the stud is a hollow stud in LDraw
accept.fat2x1_hinge_pin: same hinge brick; the knuckles are simpler in the game
accept.flat1x1: tile; the game's has a bevel
accept.flat2x1: tile; the game's has a bevel
accept.flat4x1: tile; the game's has a bevel
accept.flat6x1: tile; the game's has a bevel
accept.flat8x1: tile; the game's has a bevel
accept.support_angle: same stanchion; the game's cross bars are simpler
accept.lever: same lever; the game's ends are rounder
accept.shutter: same shutter; the game's has no slats
accept.thin2x1_hook: same plate with bar; the bar is 0.05 longer
accept.klaxon: same element; the game's rockets are simpler
accept.fat10x1: same brick, 0.08 shorter in the game: the body is fitted, the studs stay on the grid
accept.fat12x1: same brick, 0.08 shorter in the game: the body is fitted, the studs stay on the grid
accept.roadsign_oct: same sign; the game's has two slots

reject.camera_body: no LDraw counterpart: the game's camera body is a custom shape
reject.car_dash: no LDraw counterpart: the game's dashboard is a custom shape
reject.car_engine: no LDraw counterpart: custom engine block
reject.dingy_pummel: no LDraw counterpart: custom dinghy fender
reject.dingy_prop: the LDraw hinge bar does not reproduce the game's propeller shaft (artefacts)
reject.fat1x1_headlight: LDraw's headlight brick has a recess with a stud, the game's a lamp bump
reject.fat2x2_pin: pin 0.08 longer than the game's (box error 0.08)
reject.fat2x1_pin: pin 0.08 longer than the game's (box error 0.08)
reject.fat1x2_45slopeinvert: LDraw's inverted slopes have a stepped top with hollow studs; the game's are flat-topped
reject.fat3x3_33slopeinvert: the nearest part (4161, a normal slope) has 3 of the game's 9 studs at the wrong height: not an inverted double slope
reject.fat4x3_33slopeinvert: no LDraw part with this shape (double inverted slope)
reject.fat4x2_dbinv45: no LDraw part with this shape (double inverted slope)
reject.fat6x6_boatbow: LDraw's boat base is hollow with other ribs than the game's solid bow
reject.fat4x4_18slope_cnr: no LDraw part with this shape
reject.wedge4x4_triple_but: the game's wedge has a recess (button) that the LDraw wedge does not
reject.wedge6x4_invert: no LDraw part with this shape
reject.hook: no LDraw counterpart: the game's hook is a custom anchor shape
reject.lever_base: the LDraw control-stick base does not match the game's dome
reject.l_s_globe: the LDraw control-stick base does not match the game's globe
reject.hemisphere4x4: the LDraw hemisphere is a cratered rock
reject.hemisphere4x4_base: no LDraw part with this shape
reject.wheel01: the LDraw wheel has a tyre tread and another width (box 0.08); the game's is a plain chunky tyre
reject.wheel02: the puck 44848 has the shape (mean 0.04) but no hub colour (the second colour would be lost); the integral-tyre wheel 6600 is mean 0.12
reject.hose_nozzle: no LDraw counterpart: the game's nozzle is a custom shape
reject.roof2x1_sloped: the game's roof is a hipped pyramid, LDraw's a plain slope
reject.roof4x2_sloped: the game's roof is a hipped pyramid, LDraw's a plain slope
reject.roof2x2_sloped_cnr: the game's roof is a hipped pyramid, LDraw's a plain slope
reject.car_base4x10: LDraw's car base has rows of studs and tubes the game's simplified base does not
reject.car_mudguard: LDraw's slope has no arch cut-out
reject.wing4x4: the game's wing is a trapezoid plate, LDraw's a plain plate with a hinge
reject.flat1x4_tophinge: box error 0.069: the hinge height differs
reject.fat1x1_6h: the LDraw pillar is round with a base, the game's square
reject.fat1x1_roundhole: the game's has a hole in the stud, LDraw's hollow stud is solid here
reject.door4x3_window: the game's door is a frame with a pane; no LDraw door with this shape
reject.door4x6_1pane: no LDraw door with this shape
reject.door4x5_1pane: two-colour door (frame + pane): LDraw's door frame is thinner and its pane a separate glass part
reject.door4x5_4pane: two-colour door (frame + panes): the panes are not a separate colour in the LDraw door
reject.door4x5_6pane: two-colour door (frame + panes): the panes are not a separate colour in the LDraw door
reject.thin2x2_hole: LDraw's closest part (plate with rubber foot) is another element
reject.wedge6x4: the LDraw wedge has 6 studs on its top, the game's 4: not the same element
reject.windscreen6x3: the LDraw slope has 2 studs on its top, the game's 6: not the same element
reject.hinge2x2_top: the LDraw hinge plate has 4 studs, the game's 2
reject.fat6x2_45dslope_: the LDraw slope has studs on both decks, the game's on one: the stud layout and the triangle budget do not fit
reject.shutter: the LDraw shutter has 400+ triangles of slats against the game's flat panel (72): over the budget at a useful accuracy
reject.window2x4x3_sloped: LDraw windscreen 2352 has no glass part: the game's pane (second colour) would have no counterpart
reject.window1x4x3_shut: a compound (window with two opened shutters): no single library part (best: mean 0.073, box 0.011) and the frames have no glass
reject.window_info_cornersolid: 4737 (outward sloping panel) is another element (mean 0.111) and has no glass part for the game's pane
reject.window_info_straight: 4741 (outward sloping window) has no glass part in the library: the pane would be lost; mean 0.108, looked at: open frame only
reject.window1x4x4_1pane: no window 1x4x4 with glass in the library (40527 + a 1x3x3 glass leaves the lower part open: looked at, wrong)
reject.window6x2_45dslope: 78522 is a curved slope, the game's is flat (mean 0.12)
reject.fat2x2_eye: the eye is a print in LDraw (no geometry): the plain brick would lose the game's second colour (68 vertices)
reject.fat1x1_eye: the eye is a print in LDraw (no geometry): the plain brick would lose the game's second colour (34 vertices)

window_bay.note: bay window: LDraw frame + brown glass; the glass is the second colour

window1x4x3.note: train window 1x4x3 with its glass pane (second colour); the game has more mullions in some variants

window1x4x3_.note: train window 1x4x3 with its glass pane (second colour); the game has more mullions in some variants

window1x4x3_1pane.note: train window 1x4x3 with its glass pane (second colour); the game has more mullions in some variants

window4x6_3pane.note: window frame with three panes + its glass

window4x4x3sloped_2pane.note: sloped roof window with centre bar and glass

window4x2.note: window 1x4x2 classic with sill and glass

window_bay_mantle.note: brick 4x10 without two corners = the base of the bay window

fat1x2_45slopeinvert.note: inverted slope 45 2x1; one stud sits in a pocket in LDraw (the game has a flat deck)

fat2x2_45slopeinvert.note: inverted slope 45 2x2; the two front studs sit in a pocket in LDraw (the game has a flat deck)

fat4x2_dbinv45.note: double inverted slope 45 4x2 with open centre

flat1x4_tophinge.note: hinge tile 1x4; the hinge is 0.069 lower than in the game, the body is fitted

fat2x2_pin.note: brick 2x2 with pin; the pin is 0.08 longer than the game's and has friction ridges

fat2x1_pin.note: brick 1x2 with pin; the pin is 0.08 longer than the game's

fat1x1_headlight.note: headlight brick: LDraw has the lamp recess, the game a moulded round lamp

fat1x1_roundhole.note: round brick 1x1; its stud is hollow in LDraw (built solid), the game's has a hole

car_steeringwheel.note: steering stand and wheel; the stand is the second colour

lever_base.note: control stick base (faceted dome with notch)

l_s_globe.note: control stick base used as the globe (faceted dome)

shutter.note: window shutter 1x2x3 with slats (the game has a flat panel)

bar7x3_clips.note: bar 7x3 with four clips; the clips are slightly different in size

dingy_prop.note: hinge bar with three fingers and a stud (propeller shaft); fine decimation keeps the grooves clean

wheel01.note: wheel rim with tyre 12/40x11 (centre band): the tyre is the second colour; the real tyre has a tread, the game's is smooth

car_mudguard.note: car mudguard 3x4 with the arch cut-out

fat6x6_boatbow.note: boat base 6x6 (the underside is closed like the game's solid bow)

car_seat.note: brick 2x4x2 with triple curved top (the seat back)
